# Rust API Reference

The {rust-api}`API reference on docs.rs <index.html>` documents the public types, functions, and methods in `vl-convert-rs`.

See {doc}`advanced/rust-converter` for creating and sharing a converter, or {doc}`getting-started/quick-start` for a complete conversion example.
